posts.title: On Together
posts.description: I'm making a mod for the game On Together . In On Together you just.. hang out with people, usually on the beach. You meet all sorts of cool people doing all sorts of things: co-working, studying for exams, doing chores around the house. And you do them together! I've been hanging out in there for the past month working on various personal projects. My mod: has a custom map: a cozy bar at the top
